series.name: Gemini Series UPS (LED/LCD)
series.notes: Official Gemini datasheet INDICATORS + ALARM (PowerHouse Express CDN + brand Wayback image). Symbolic LED/beep IDs — 0 numeric codes.

meaning.en: Green LED lit — UPS on mains/AC utility mode
meaning.ur: harey LED roshan — UPS se chal raha hai

causes.ur: Normal status — utility aa rahi hai

solutions.ur: Kuch nahi karna — normal chal raha hai

meaning.en: Running on battery; buzzer sounds every 4 seconds
meaning.ur: battery par chal raha hai buzzer har 4 second

causes.en: mains failure / UPS in battery mode
causes.ur: Mains gayab ho gaye ya UPS battery par chal raha hai

solutions.ur: Mains wapas layein aur input supply check karein

notes.en: no separate LED row for "battery mode" beyond alarm; pair with yellow-LED only when low battery
notes.ur: Battery mode ke liye alarm ke ilawa koi alag LED row nahi hai; sirf low battery par hi peeli LED ke saath pair karein.

meaning.en: Yellow LED flashing every second + buzzer sounding every second
meaning.ur: Peeli LED har second chamke aur buzzer har second bajta hai

causes.ur: Battery discharge ho gayi ya backup khatam ho gaya

solutions.en: reduce load, charge battery, check battery health
solutions.ur: Load kam karein, battery charge karein aur battery health check karein

notes.en: distinct from "Battery Weak at AC modes"
notes.ur: Yeh alag cheez hai, "Battery Weak at AC modes" se

meaning.en: Red LED flashing twice every second; LCD models also buzzer every second
meaning.ur: Laal LED har second do baar chamke; LCD model par buzzer bhi har second bajta hai.

causes.ur: Load UPS ki rating se zyada hai

causes.en: More appliances added over time than the UPS can carry
causes.ur: Waqt ke saath zyada appliances lag gaye jo UPS carry nahi kar sakta

solutions.en: Power off the UPS and isolate the AC supply before checking the load wiring.
solutions.ur: Load wiring check karne se pehle UPS band karke AC supply isolate karein.

solutions.en: Remove extra appliances so the total load stays below the UPS rating, then power on and watch the LED.
solutions.ur: Zyada appliances utarein taake total load UPS rating se neeche rahe, phir on karke LED dekhein.

solutions.en: If the overload still shows on a light load, disconnect the load and have a technician check the output board and relay.
solutions.ur: Halka load hone par bhi overload dikhe to load disconnect karke technician se output board aur relay check karwayein.

source.title: official Gemini datasheet INDICATORS (short) + full 1250 PDF ALARM "Over load: Sounding every second" + electro.pk mirro

notes.en: electro.pk omits overload beep row — see Conflicts
notes.ur: electro.pk par overload beep wali row nahi — Conflicts dekhein

codes.blinkPattern: red flash 2× per 1 s; beep 1 Hz (full datasheet)

meaning.en: Red LED flashing every 2 seconds for 30 seconds
meaning.ur: Laal LED 2 second par chamke, 30 second tak.

causes.ur: AC par chalte waqt battery kamzor ya purani hai (pre-alarm)

solutions.ur: Battery test karein ya badlein; charge voltage verify karein

codes.blinkPattern: red flash every 2 s for 30 s

meaning.en: Red LED lighting three times every 2 seconds
meaning.ur: Laal LED har 2 second par teen baar roshan hoti hai.

causes.en: battery open/short/reverse or charger cannot maintain battery
causes.ur: Battery open, short ya ulti hai ya charger battery ko theek se charge nahi kar pata

causes.en: Battery old and weak or its terminals corroded
causes.ur: Battery purani aur kamzor hai ya uske terminals par zang laga hai

solutions.en: Power off the UPS, isolate AC and disconnect the battery before any test.
solutions.ur: Kisi bhi test se pehle UPS power off karke AC isolate karein aur battery disconnect karein.

solutions.en: Check battery terminals for loose, reversed or corroded connections, then fix the polarity and tighten them.
solutions.ur: Battery terminals dhile, ulte ya zang lage hain check karein, phir polarity theek karke kassein.

solutions.en: Measure battery voltage with a multimeter and load-test it — a battery that fails is replaced, otherwise a technician checks the internal fuse and charger.
solutions.ur: Multimeter se battery voltage naap kar load-test karein — battery fail ho to badlein, warna technician andar ka fuse aur charger check kare.

notes.ur: Yeh number wala code nahi hai

meaning.en: Red LED solid/lit + buzzer continuously sounding
meaning.ur: Laal LED musalsal roshan + buzzer musalsal bajta hai.

causes.en: internal UPS fault (generic; datasheet does not subdivide)
causes.ur: UPS ke andar ka fault (generic; datasheet mein alag alag nahi bataya)
Andar ka board ya relay fail ho gaya

solutions.en: Power off the UPS, isolate AC and remove the load and battery before opening it.
solutions.ur: UPS kholne se pehle power off karein, AC isolate karein aur load aur battery hata dein.

solutions.en: Power-cycle once with load and battery still disconnected: AC off, wait a few minutes, then AC on.
solutions.ur: Jab tak load aur battery disconnect hain, ek baar power cycle karein: AC off, kuch minute intezaar, phir AC on.

solutions.en: If the solid red LED and the beep continue, do not keep restarting — the UPS goes to a service centre.
solutions.ur: Agar laal LED aur beep jaari rahein to baar baar restart na karein - UPS ko service centre le jayein.

notes.ur: Fault ke liye koi sub-code publish nahi hai
